_readme: THE LINE (2026-10-28): impact_convergence.json's 1 km stone carried to the shore -- the departure every sim-minute at the impact and along the line from it to the anchor at 300, 600, 1200, 1800 and 2400 km on the chart (SweSolver::kProbeKm), the spin-up from half an hour before the stone to 6.5 h after it, when the shore scene's probe saw the train at the anchor. Where the amplitude goes between 300 km (a converged 35 m front) and the shore (0.3 m) is read off the line: 1/sqrt(r) is spreading, the rest is the scheme's -- run once with the old linear damping stated as its e-folding time (--set water.swe.dampH=2.44: 0.99995 a 0.44 s substep) and once without (the default).
Runs:  build in\gagame.exe scenes\demos\impact_line.json --headless --frames 30 --set streaming.offline=true --set water.swe.dampH=2.44
